title: Fix bù and yī while they are still cheap
summary: Correct the two automatic tone shifts now, before they harden into a habit you say all day.
attribution: Original content authored for this project.

blocks.body: Two shifts happen without any spelling change, and both appear in the first sentences you will speak. 不 bù becomes bú right before a fourth tone, so 不是 bú shì (to be not) and 不要 bú yào (to not want) rise, while 不好 bù hǎo (not good) stays flat. 一 yī becomes yì before a first, second, or third tone, yí before a fourth, and a light syllable between repeated verbs, as in 看一看 kàn yi kan (have a look). Practise each shift in a fixed phrase rather than as a rule, so the change comes out of muscle memory. Fix them now while you only say 不知道 bù zhīdào (I do not know) a dozen times a day.
